text:
```artifact
Feature: Lab Management System

  Scenario: Lab In-charge views and updates open lab-requests
    Given the lab-in-charge is logged in
    And there are open lab-requests
    When the lab-in-charge views the open lab-requests
    Then the lab-in-charge should see the open lab-requests
    And the lab-in-charge should have the option to update the status
    And the lab-in-charge should be able to update the status to "Actual Sample Collection" and "Lab Tests"
    And the lab-in-charge should be able to submit reports to the patient offline

  Scenario: Patient views and prints the Prescription and invoice
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient has a Prescription
    When the patient views the Prescription
    Then the patient should see the Prescription
    And the patient should have the option to print the invoice
    And the patient should be able to print the invoice
    And the admin should have the option to print and email the Prescription and invoice

  Scenario: Quarterly archiving of Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests
    Given the system is running
    And the system is configured to archive Patient Profiles and Consultation Requests quarterly
    When the system runs the quarterly archiving process
    Then the system should archive Patient Profiles which have not raised any Consultation Request for the last 3 years
    And the system should archive Consultation Requests that are more than 3 years old
```
